current_evidence: The PDF ('Local Information Requirements for Validation', January 2024) is still the downloadable list and is the one registered on planning.data.gov.uk (start date 2024-01-01). However, the council's HTML version of the same list has newer content not in the PDF: an 'Outline fire strategy / safety report' for large-scale BESS (following the June 2025 Cabinet BESS decision), 'National Landscape' wording for the LVA, and BNG for major development 'from February 2024'. The HTML page shows no date, so its exact revision date is unknown.

issues.detail: Grokbot uses the January 2024 PDF as the list of record. The council's web-page version of the list has been revised since. It adds an Outline Fire Strategy/Safety Report for large-scale non-domestic Battery Energy Storage Systems. It expands the Landscape requirement to development 'within or near' a National Landscape and some countryside applications. It reduces the Water Neutrality Statement to 'where necessary' with no trigger. The PDF's BNG wording ('unless excluded by forthcoming guidance and secondary legislation') is also out of date. Grokbot's 'Outdated (>2y)? Yes' flag is right for the PDF, but the more current HTML list was not used as the primary source.
issues.evidence: HTML page: 'Outline fire strategy / safety report' for large-scale (non-domestic) BESS; PDF dated January 2024

issues.detail: Many local requirements are missing from app_type_rows: Arboricultural Statement/Tree Survey (trees on or adjacent to the site, in a Conservation Area or under a TPO; BS5837 survey for minor and major applications); Daylight/Sunlight Assessment (increased height with potential significant impact on neighbours); Environmental Impact Assessment; Essential Rural Workers Statement (new rural worker dwellings); Marketing Information (loss of employment, retail or community uses; at least 12 months' marketing); Minerals Resource Assessment (major and minor development above thresholds in Minerals Consultation Zones, outline or full only); Retail Impact Statement (out-of-centre retail or town centre uses over 1,000 sqm); Structural Statement and Survey (especially barn conversions); Surface Water Drainage Statement (all buildings, hard surfacing and extensions); Utilities/Services Strategy (100+ dwellings or 10,000 sqm+); Outline fire strategy for BESS (HTML version); Section plans (floor level changes, sloping ground, infill or driveways).
issues.evidence: PDF local requirements table rows 3, 7, 9, 10, 18, 19, 23, 25, 26, 31; HTML page 'Outline fire strategy / safety report'
issues.grok_comment: Most of the listed items are indeed missing. But the Surface Water Drainage Statement does have a row: "Drainage Strategy / SuDS" under Full planning, whose trigger ("NPPF priorities for sustainable drainage to apply to all development...") comes from that item. The trigger is garbled and incomplete, though.
issues.claude_response: Partly accepted. SuDS has a (garbled) row. The other missing items stand.

issues.detail: 'Planning Statement' is listed under Householder, but the source explicitly excludes householder applications. The trigger excerpt Grokbot quotes says so itself.
issues.evidence: 'Planning Statement Required for all major development and for all minor development excluding householder applications.'

issues.detail: Householder has only a block plan with measured trees and the wrongly placed Planning Statement. Local requirements that cover householder work are missing from it: Surface Water Drainage Statement ('all buildings, hard surfacing and extensions'); Roof plans for loft conversions and dormers (placed under Full planning instead); Tree Survey; Heritage Statement where a heritage asset is affected; Biodiversity Survey; Lighting Assessment ('any sort of illumination', including security lighting); Daylight/Sunlight Assessment; Flood Risk Assessment in Flood Zones 2/3; CIL Additional Information form (extensions creating floorspace).
issues.evidence: Surface Water Drainage Statement: 'All buildings, hard surfacing, and extensions'; Roof plans: 'Required for all loft conversions, or applications including the erection of a dormer window.'

issues.detail: Advertisement consent is '(none)', but the list requires Advert Details Plans for all advertisement consent applications. Grokbot's own tab_items quote this. Separately, the 'Advertisement drawings / illumination details' row under Full planning actually carries the Lighting Assessment trigger text.
issues.evidence: 'Advert Details Plans Required for all advertisement consent applications.'

issues.detail: About 27 requirements are placed under Full planning with 'INFERRED: application type not named... placed under Full planning'. Examples: Affordable Housing Statement, Air Quality, Energy Statement, Transport Assessment, Viability, Water Neutrality. Outline gets only LVIA, and Reserved matters, Listed building consent, Prior approval and S73 are all '(none)'. The source sets triggers by scale and site conditions, not by application type. Minerals Resource Assessment is expressly for 'outline or full applications'. Heritage Statement covers designated assets, so it applies to listed building consent.
issues.evidence: Minerals Resource Assessment trigger (outline or full only); Heritage Statement 'designated and non-designated' heritage assets

issues.detail: Several rows carry another requirement's trigger text. 'Contaminated Land / Land Contamination Assessment' quotes the Heritage Statement trigger ('Required when proposed works would directly or indirectly impact a heritage asset'); the real trigger is known or suspected contamination, or land near it. 'Planning Statement' (Full planning) quotes the Minerals Resource Assessment text. 'Drainage Strategy / SuDS' quotes the Telecommunications text. 'Ecological Survey' runs into the CIL form text. 'Noise Impact Assessment' runs into Open Space. 'Ventilation / Extraction' runs into the CIL Appendix. 'Planning Obligations / S106' quotes viability text.
issues.evidence: Land Contamination Assessment row: known or suspected contamination, or sites near such land

issues.detail: Several triggers are vague or cut off where the source gives specific thresholds. Air Quality ('when an Air Quality Assessment... is required to be submitted'): the source says major development, sites in or near the Cowfold or Storrington AQMA, or B8 of 500 sqm+. Viability: the source says major residential (10+ dwellings) where full S106 contributions are claimed to be unviable. Statement of Community Involvement ('adopted Horsham SCI, the Localism Act 2011 and the NPPF'): the source says major development of 10+ dwellings or 1,000 sqm+. Archaeological desk-based assessment ends at 'within the following boundaries' and omits the red/amber Archaeological Notification Area thresholds (e.g. over 0.2ha, over 0.5ha, 10+ units).

The Water Neutrality Statement trigger leaves out that it applies to all applications except householder schemes, so the row is wrongly limited to Full planning. The HTML version now gives no trigger beyond 'where necessary'. A separate 'Water efficiency / water usage statement' row is just a sentence describing the content of the Water Neutrality Statement.
issues.evidence: PDF: Water Neutrality Statement - all applications except householder schemes; '(with the exception of a householder scheme)'

issues.detail: Several tab_items are process text or fragments rather than requirements. 'Submission rules' covers the two hard copies, Planning Portal submission, USB/FTP for large schemes and pre-application advice. 'Policy-driven requirements' includes a garbled run of headings ('Policy 40 ... Water Neutrality Statement Utilities/Services Strategy/Assessmen t Ventilation ExtractionStatement Anyone considering...') and 'Consideration should be given to Water Neutrality ahead of...'. Drawing standards include the bare fragment 'To be drawn at a metric scale of 1:50 or 1:100.' and one ending 'must show:'.
issues.evidence: tab_items sections 'Submission rules' and 'Drawing / document standards'

issues.detail: Duplicated entries: the major-application hard-copy text appears twice (PDF and web page); 'To be drawn at a metric scale of 1:50 or 1:100.' appears twice; the general drawing guidance appears twice; Heritage Statement and Contaminated Land share the same excerpt; the Sequential Test text appears in both the Flood Risk and Sequential Test rows; Block plan appears under both Householder and Full; Telecommunications text appears in both the Drainage and Telecommunications rows.
issues.evidence: tab_items 4/11 and 2/7; app_type_rows Heritage vs Contaminated Land

summary: Grokbot's PDF link works and is the January 2024 Horsham list still offered for download, but the council's HTML version has been revised since (it adds a BESS fire strategy and updates the landscape and water neutrality wording). The extraction misses about 12 local requirements, puts Planning Statement under Householder although the source excludes householder, marks Advertisement consent as having no requirements, and has several triggers copied from neighbouring rows.
